title: Live mirror and unit HUD
hook: Watch the live **12×5 mirror** of the board in the browser, with a **unit HUD** above each unit — identity, shield, and statuses at a glance.

blindSpots.meaning: A live copy of the 12×5 board in the control room — observation and orders, not a second physics engine.
Chips above each unit (identity, shield, statuses). You do not need a second panel to read the board under pressure.
High-level commands from the control room. You are not rewriting pea physics.
Does not destroy the board. You stay on the Lawn stage.
Match state on the mirror (sun bank, wave, phase) — separate from RPG stock souls.

alsoTrue: Shield and status chips use the shipped combat language — [shields, crit, and resistance](shields-crit-resist) · [statuses](statuses).
Deployed specimens and the commander chip show here when present.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Open the Lawn stage while a match is running.
You see plants, zombies, sun, wave clock, match phase, commander chip, deployed specimens, and statuses — live.

sections.title: How you use it
sections.intro: Observe first, then issue orders when you need them:

cards.name: Read
cards.body: Unit HUD carries identity, shield, and the statuses that matter at a glance.

cards.name: Order
cards.body: High-level orders only — you are not a second physics engine.

cards.name: Stay
cards.body: Closing overlays does not dump you off the stage or wipe the board.

diagram: lawn game board  --live-->  12x5 mirror + unit HUD

groups.title: In the control room
steps: Start a match in the lawn game.
Open the control room and select Lawn.
Read the mirror and HUD without hunting a second deep panel for every status.
groups.note: If the mirror is still, the match may not be running or the injector may not be connected — fix that before blaming the UI.

doSteps: Open Lawn and confirm a moving 12×5 mirror.
Point at one unit HUD and name identity, shield, or a status chip.
doNote: Parent loop: [lawn match](lawn-match). Field demons onto that board: [bound demon deploy](lawn-deploy).

mixUps.q: Is the mirror a second game I play with the mouse?
mixUps.a: You observe and issue high-level orders. The lawn game still owns the board physics.

mixUps.q: Do I need to open a detail panel for every status?
mixUps.a: No. Unit HUD is built for glance reading under pressure.

mixUps.q: Did I break the match when I closed a menu?
mixUps.a: Closing a menu does not destroy the board — you stay on the stage.

mixUps.q: Is mirror sun the same as souls?
mixUps.a: No. Match sun is board state. Souls are the RPG stock — see [souls](souls).
Shield chips appear when overlay shields are present — see [shields, crit, and resistance](shields-crit-resist).
